title: Transformation: cleaning, joining, deriving and aggregating

videos.script: The raw layer holds what the sources said. Nobody can report from it yet. {{raw}} One publisher writes ISBNs with hyphens. Another sends prices as text. Seventy prices match no book at all. {{messy}} The website sent seventy-eight events twice. {{twice}} And a join between payments and order lines nearly doubles the shop's revenue, without a single error. {{fanout}} Then there is the date. The same order is placed on Friday in São Paulo, and on Saturday on a server set to UTC. {{zone}} This lesson cleans, deduplicates, joins, derives and aggregates, one SQL file at a time. {{files}} And at the end it adds the shop's revenue up three different ways. The three numbers agree to the cent. That agreement is the test.
